name: Aegis Overdrive (Combat)
body:
Use their strength against them and watch them fell themselves.

Prerequisite(s): Con 15, BAB +7, Aegis Slam, Shield Focus, Skewering Aegis Style

Benefits: While using this style, you gain a bonus on damage rolls equal to your shield bonus to AC against creatures that missed you with an attack in the previous round and increase the damage multiplier of your attack readied against a charge by 1.

A Land Out of Time 2013, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
